title: Teaching discovery was silently broken — skip silently masked all hub connectivity failures
signal: wai.md Step 5 teaching discovery had two bugs: (1) scan path was hub/framework/*.teaching — directory never existed; correct path is hub/teachings_repo/framework/current/. (2) 'If hub_path is null or inaccessible: skip silently' — this masked a fundamental connectivity failure across all spokes. Every wakeup silently found zero teachings. Fixed: hub path validation now runs before scanning, both failure modes surface as visible warnings in the Step 7 briefing under Context Health.
rationale: Silent failure of the teaching distribution mechanism meant all connected spokes were deaf to framework updates. The mechanism appeared healthy but was non-functional. Observable errors are required for essential infrastructure.
